BUTCHR-114 reviewing as instrument for BUTCHR-138 Arm A (base-merge).

REVIEWED-SHA: 54311340c1986254c015372283edc300df7ce1d9

This is a throwaway measurement instrument, not a deliverable. Approving it is an act of running the experiment, not a judgement that anything should merge. DO NOT MERGE. Verified before approving: single new file under docs/review-commit-immutability/, 5 added lines, self-describing as scratch; branch is 13 commits behind origin/main, so the Arm A base-merge will produce a real merge commit rather than a fast-forward.

The sha above is written into this body deliberately: the review body is one of the two candidate immutable records under test in BUTCHR-138. Compare it against .commit_id at T0 and again at T1.
